theorems.name: Submission.cbrg_ae_orient_iUnion
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) → ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (W N : ι → Set (Euclid P)) (R : (i : ι) → IMRep (W i) k) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (N i)) → (∀ i, N i ⊆ (R i).carrier) → (⋃ i, N i) ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[k] ((⋃ i, N i) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[k].restrict (N i)), ξ y = (R i).orient y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict (⋃ i, N i)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k (⋃ i, N i) x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q
